question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: "**revolves**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb "**revolves**" means to move in a circular motion around a central point. (किसी केंद्रीय बिंदु के चारों ओर गोलाकार गति में घूमना) • **Example**: *As the Earth revolves around the sun, it causes the changing seasons throughout the year.* • The sentence suggests that something is moving around a central point, which fits the definition of "**revolves**". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Rotates: **Turns around a central point. (एक केंद्रीय बिंदु के चारों ओर घूमता है) • **Squares: **Geometric shapes with four equal sides and angles. (चार समान भुजाओं और कोणों वाली ज्यामितीय आकृतियाँ) • **Circles: **Round shapes with a continuous curved boundary. (सतत घुमावदार सीमा के साथ गोल आकार) 48:T848, The correct answer is: **Transmit**
